caution: Read from Tobi's MusicXML file (Tobis Notenarchiv), notes, ties and names as they stand there; the voices were sorted by this program from the file's staves, stems and beams, and have not been proofread note by note. The pedal's line is the bass.
title: Fantasia and Fugue in G minor, BWV 542: Fugue

sections.label: Episode 1
sections.summary: Alto: a figure from the subject (3 times) and a figure from countersubject 1 and a figure from the subject, inverted, in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Tenor: a figure from the subject (3 times) and a figure from countersubject 1 (2 times) and a figure from the subject, inverted (2 times), in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Bass: a figure from the subject (2 times), in a sequence falling by a step every bar.
sections.leads: From D minor to G minor; perfect cadence in G minor at bar 21

sections.label: Episode 2
sections.summary: Reworks the codetta (bars 7–9) in part, with the soprano's line in the alto, the alto's line in the tenor, transposed. Soprano: a figure from countersubject 1. Alto: a figure from the subject (3 times) and a figure from countersubject 1, inverted, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Tenor: free counterpoint.
sections.leads: From D minor to G minor

sections.label: Episode 3
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject (4 times) and a figure from countersubject 1 (3 times), in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Alto: free counterpoint. Tenor: a figure from the subject (5 times). Bass: a figure from the subject (8 times), in a sequence falling by a third every beat. Returns in Episode 11 (bars 105–110).
sections.leads: From G minor to B♭ major

sections.label: Episode 4
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject (9 times) and the opening of the subject, in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Alto: a figure from the subject (2 times) and a figure from the subject, inverted (2 times) and a figure from countersubject 1, inverted, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Tenor: a figure from the subject (8 times) and a figure from the subject, inverted (4 times), in a sequence rising by a fourth every half bar. Returns in Episode 10 (bars 96–100).
sections.leads: From B♭ major to D minor; perfect cadence in D minor at bar 43

sections.label: Answer in D minor, rhythm varied (Tenor)
Episode 5
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject. Tenor: a figure from the subject.
sections.leads: From D minor to F major

sections.label: Episode 6
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject (6 times) and a figure from the subject, inverted (4 times) and the opening of the subject and a figure from countersubject 1, in a sequence falling by a third every half bar. Alto: free counterpoint. Tenor: a figure from the subject (6 times) and a figure from the subject, inverted, in a sequence falling by a third every half bar. Bass: a figure from the subject (9 times) and a figure from the subject, inverted (5 times), in a sequence falling by a third every half bar.
sections.leads: From F major to G minor

sections.label: Episode 7
sections.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint. Alto: a figure from countersubject 1 and a figure from the subject. Tenor: a figure from the subject (4 times) and a figure from the subject, inverted (3 times) and a figure from countersubject 1 (2 times). Bass: free counterpoint.
sections.leads: From G minor to C minor; perfect cadence in G minor at bar 68; perfect cadence in C minor at bar 70

sections.label: Episode 8
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject and a figure from countersubject 1. Tenor: a figure from countersubject 1 (2 times) and a figure from the subject (2 times), in a sequence falling by a fourth every half bar. Bass: a figure from the subject.
sections.leads: From C minor to E♭ major

sections.label: Stretto: Subject in E♭ major (Bass); Subject in E♭ major (Alto)
Episode 9
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject (6 times) and a figure from the subject, inverted (4 times), in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Alto: a figure from the subject (11 times) and a figure from the subject, inverted (4 times), in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Tenor: a figure from the subject (4 times) and a figure from countersubject 1 (2 times), in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Bass: a figure from the subject (2 times), in a sequence rising by a fifth every two bars.
sections.leads: From E♭ major to G minor

sections.label: Episode 10
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 4 (bars 39–50), in the same voices, a fifth lower. Soprano: a figure from the subject (8 times), in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Tenor: a figure from the subject (4 times), in a sequence rising by a fourth every half bar.
sections.leads: Between two statements in G minor

sections.label: Answer in G minor, rhythm varied (Tenor); Subject in G minor (Alto)
Episode 11
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 3 (bars 32–36) in part, with the bass's line in the tenor, a third lower. Soprano: a figure from the subject (3 times) and a figure from countersubject 1 (2 times), in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Alto: a figure from the subject (2 times) and a figure from countersubject 1, inverted, in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Tenor: a figure from the subject (7 times) and a figure from countersubject 1, in a sequence falling by a third every beat.
sections.leads: Between two statements in G minor

sections.label: Coda
sections.leads: Perfect cadence in G minor at bar 115

spans.label: Codetta
spans.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject (3 times) and a figure from the subject, inverted (2 times) and a figure from countersubject 1, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Alto: a figure from countersubject 1, inverted. Returns in Episode 2 (bars 27–29).

spans.label: Codetta
spans.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint. Alto: free counterpoint. Tenor: a figure from the subject (4 times) and a figure from countersubject 1, inverted, in a sequence rising by a third every half bar.
